First we check the parameters for our chosen crop: Almonds

```{r}
source("crop_yield.R")
crop_yield('list')
```
## Test the function

```{r}

# Read climate data
clim <- read.table("clim.txt", header = TRUE)
# Extract February minimum temperature for each year
feb_tmin <- aggregate(tmin_c ~ year, 
                      data = clim[clim$month == 2, ], 
                      FUN = mean)
# Extract January precipitation for each year
jan_precip <- aggregate(precip ~ year, 
                        data = clim[clim$month == 1, ], 
                        FUN = sum)
# Merge the datasets
almond_data <- merge(feb_tmin, jan_precip, by = "year")
names(almond_data) <- c("year", "feb_tmin", "jan_precip")
# Calculate yield anomaly using the crop_yield function
almond_data$yield_anomaly <- mapply(crop_yield,
                                    crop = "Almonds",
                                    temp_1 = almond_data$feb_tmin,
                                    precip_1 = almond_data$jan_precip)
# Display summary statistics
cat("Maximum yield anomaly:", max(almond_data$yield_anomaly), "ton/acre\n")
cat("Minimum yield anomaly:", min(almond_data$yield_anomaly), "ton/acre\n")
cat("Mean yield anomaly:", mean(almond_data$yield_anomaly), "ton/acre\n")
```
